topology_notes: An open U-section formed by a horizontal top member (W2) connecting a vertical left member (W3) and a vertical right member (W1). W3 is taller than W1. The section has two re-entrant corners.
alignment_notes: The top edges of W1, W2, and W3 are aligned. The inner vertical edge of W3 aligns with the start of the 50 dimension. The inner vertical edge of W1 aligns with the end of the 200 dimension. The horizontal dashed line aligns with the bottom of W2. The vertical dashed line is a reference axis.
